intendedUse: 17 source-linked Big Ten basketball interiors, plus unchanged specialist OSU reference; eight with reviewed chart adjacency and nine with illustrative school-distinct bowl shapes
geometryStatus: chart-informed/manual estimates: NOT surveyed section vertex coordinates or verified seating inventory
notes: Official section identity is preserved from reference charts, where supported, but exact seating row/polygon geometry remains unsurveyed. Removed invented first-wave taper, portal, trim omissions. The nine additional interiors have no fake student blocks or fake portals and do not claim chart-calibrated layouts.

indiana.notes: Two opposing side banks and separate balcony banks follow the official 2026–27 seating diagram. Mid-bank notch positions are visual estimates, not surveyed portals. Unsupported internal aisle notches and unsupported student-seat furniture have been removed. Wedge taper and seat-row shape remain illustrative estimates. Section order is controlled only by data/big-ten/section-chart-verified-order.json. Legacy repeated section width patterns are deleted. Unsurveyed frontWidth/rearWidth taper factors and simulated row trims are discarded. Only published physical section gaps may remove seat runs.

minnesota.notes: Williams Arena elevated playing floor and historic side stands are documented. The linked 2007–08 section drawing is historical and NOT proof of current 2026 labels, row counts or section adjacency.

nebraska.notes: Official Pinnacle Bank Arena basketball chart confirms all three numbered 100/200/300 layers and ADA tiers. Faceted outline and level geometry here remain diagram-derived estimates.

northwestern.notes: Official venue information confirms MAIN/UPPER levels, while exact row and portal geometry is unknown. Do not fabricate the Wilson Club gap.

oregon.notes: Matthew Knight Arena's angular enclosure motivates a faceted interior study. Individual 101–121 and 201–221 section footprints are still seating-diagram estimates, not physical measurements.

penn-state.notes: Bryce Jordan Center official basketball seating chart separates the 100 and 200 seating gallery with nonseating premium spaces. Missing row/section edge data are not artificially filled with portals.

rutgers.notes: Rutgers Athletics confirms 100 courtside and student zones, 201–217 mezzanine and 301–317 promenade around the RAC. The 100/200/300 area boundaries and court loges are not surveyed.

usc.notes: USC's current men's basketball diagram shows a 100 level, 200 level and two separate rows of courtside. 100/200 polygons are estimates and courtside inventory is explicitly not generated.

seatRetentionPolicy: The model must not delete or narrow rows solely to match an illustrative fan-shaped contour. Confirmed voids and documented skipped rows are handled separately.
